proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Annual Report on Prevention of Workplace Harassment and Discrimination
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the State of New York, Thomas P. DiNapoli, Trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual public report quantifying the effectiveness of efforts to prevent harassment and discrimination against protected classes of employees, including settlements, arbitration and concealment clauses.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Third-Party Assessment of Respect for Freedom of Association and Collective Bargaining
proposals.proponent: Segal Marco Advisors on behalf of the AFL-CIO Equity Index Funds
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party assessment of Wells Fargo's respect for freedom of association and collective bargaining, with remedial steps, publicly disclosed.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Respecting Indigenous Peoples' Rights
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on effectiveness of policies and performance in respecting Indigenous Peoples' rights in corporate and project financing.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Audit of Climate Transition Policies
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audit analyzing adverse and beneficial economic and humanitarian impacts of climate transition policies on emerging nations, published on the website.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Annual Climate Lobbying Congruency Report
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Francis Dubuque Charitable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report on whether lobbying and policy influence activities align with the company's net zero by 2050 commitment.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Annual Report on Congruency of Political Spending and Corporate Values
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report analyzing congruency between stated corporate values and electioneering and policy-organization contributions, listing misaligned contributions.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Transparency in Lobbying Annual Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing lobbying policies, payments for direct, indirect and grassroots lobbying, and tax-exempt model legislation memberships and payments.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Risks of Politicized De-Banking
proposals.topic_summary: Requests evaluation and report on how the company oversees risks of discrimination against individuals based on race, religion, sex, national origin or political views in providing services.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
